items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I just have heard about that number. In fact, Clarence Williams played on a record of it, I think, with Bessie Smith, I believe.

ctx.x: I just have heard about that number. In fact, Clarence Williams played on a record of it, I think, with Bessie Smith, I believe. That's nice stuff. When did Jack Carey fit in there? I know you told me you were with Jack Carey. Yeah, I played with Jack Carey. Good luck. Was Punch with him then or was that before Punch?
That was with Punch. And a little before he took Punch.
